# Idle public items, recorded so the `no-idle-code` gate can ratchet.
#
# An entry here is a public item that no other production file names. It is a
# debt, not a permission: the list only shrinks. Wiring an item up, or deleting
# it, removes its line, and the gate fails on a line that is no longer idle so
# the file cannot rot into a permanent excuse.
#
# Do NOT add a line to silence a failure. A newly idle item means the code that
# was supposed to call it does not, which is the finding.
#
# Format: <path>\t<kind>\t<name>
# Recorded: 2026-08-25, 2077 entries.
